messages:
alex: Heads-up — we have a regression from LD-987 where KV cache eviction can OOM under a rare access pattern. Need a hotfix tonight with a tiny surface change. Proposing patch bump 3.2.4 -> 3.2.5. Cut plan: PR merged by 21:30 UTC, smoke by 22:00, deploy in the 22:30 window. Who can own the branch + PR?

maya: I can own the branch + PR. Will keep diff minimal, no config or infra touches. Expect 2-3 files changed.

sam: I can take smoke tests and changelog. What do you want in the changelog? Keep it short.

alex: Short: "Fix KV cache eviction edge-case causing OOM under heavy interleaved access (LD-987)". No behavior change beyond safety guard. Mention no migrations.

jordan: Will review ASAP. Ping me when PR is up and I'll do a quick pass. If it's small I can merge once CI is green.

maya: Working now. Branch name: hotfix/kv-evict-3.2.5. Steps I'll follow: create branch, cherry-pick the fix commit, run unit + smoke locally, push PR.

sam: Quick checklist for deploy: add release note snippet, run smoke on staging (kv-heavy workload), verify latency p95 looks normal. I'll coordinate with oncall.

maya: Command snippet I'm using:
```
# create hotfix branch and cherry-pick commit
git checkout -b hotfix/kv-evict-3.2.5 origin/main
git cherry-pick -x abcdef12345
# run local smoke
make -j6 unit test && make smoke-kv
```

maya: PR will target main and I'll include the minimal changelog entry in the PR description. Will also include a single test to cover the eviction path.

jordan: FYI, avoid touching the batching path in this PR — that was the noisy area in the last roll. Keep scope strict.

alex: Agreed, no batching changes. Also leave rollout as single-region canary -> global if canary ok. Canary criteria: no OOMs + <5% error increase + latency regressions below 5% p95.

release-bot: release-bot: noted release window placeholder 22:30 UTC. Tagging release channel for oncall awareness.

sam: Oncall (@jordan) — can you be available for the 22:30 deploy in case we need immediate rollback?

jordan: Yep, I'll be around. If merge happens earlier I can validate canary.

maya: PR opened: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/7821 (hotfix/kv-evict-3.2.5). Description includes changelog and test. @jordan please review.

jordan: Reviewing now. Small nit: add a short comment explaining the guard so future readers know why return early is safe.

maya: Added comment and pushed. CI is green on unit tests, smoke pending on staging.

sam: Staging smoke started at 2301023520. Running kv-traffic generator for 10 minutes.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: smoke run completed — no OOMs observed, error rate stable. Canary ready.

sam: Changelog entry prepared: "Fix KV cache eviction edge-case causing OOM under heavy interleaved access (LD-987). No migration required."

alex: Thumbs-up. Proceed with canary deploy at 22:30 UTC. If canary looks clean after 10m, roll to global. Keep rollback tag ready.

maya: Merged PR at 2301023600 — commit 9f8e7a. Pushed tag 3.2.5-rc1.

sam: Smoke on canary (22:30) passed. Latency and errors within thresholds. Rolling forward to global now.

jordan: Monitoring. If anything spikes I'll initiate rollback and notify channel.

alex: Thanks all. Post-deploy action items: add quick postmortem note in incidents if any follow-ups, and schedule a short retro on Monday to discuss how this slipped into main. :thumbsup:

maya: Noted. I'll open the retro ticket.

release-bot: release-bot: release 3.2.5 rolled out successfully to all regions at 2301023800.

alex: Great job everyone — minimal patch, clean rollout.
